title: Antivoid-Fall
description: AntiVoid is a lightweight and performance-friendly Paper plugin that protects players from falling into the void.
body:
AntiVoid is a lightweight and performance-friendly Paper plugin that protects players from falling into the void.

You can configure exactly which world is affected and define a minimum Y level.
If a player falls below that height, they are instantly teleported to a safe location.

✨ Features

Per-world Anti-Void protection

Configurable minimum Y level

Instant teleport to a fixed safe location

Optional warning message with color codes

Permission bypass support

No repeating tasks — event-based & efficient

⚙️ How it works

The plugin checks player movement

If a player is below the configured Y level

And inside the configured world

They are teleported to:

X: 0

Y: 67

Z: 0

Yaw: 90

Pitch: 0

📄 Requirements

Paper 1.21.1

Java 17+

🛠️ Use cases

Skyblock servers

Custom worlds

Void maps

SMP safety systems

AntiVoid focuses on simplicity, safety, and performance.
